select json_build_object(
        'registered', count(*),
        'verified', count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from public.feature_verifications fv where fv.profile_id = p.id and fv.status = 'approved')),
        'location_filled', count(*) filter (where p.location is not null and btrim(p.location) <> ''),
        'time_zone_set', count(*) filter (where p.time_zone is not null),
        'country_of_residence_set', count(*) filter (where p.country_of_residence is not null),
        'nationality_set', count(*) filter (where p.nationality is not null),
        'phone_any', count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from public.identity_accounts ia where ia.profile_id = p.id and ia.phone_number is not null)),
        'phone_verified', count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from public.identity_accounts ia where ia.profile_id = p.id and ia.phone_number_verified)),
        'signup_country_recorded', count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from public.member_signup_countries sc where sc.profile_id = p.id)),
        'session_country_known', count(*) filter (where exists (select 1 from public.auth_sessions s where s.profile_id = p.id and s.approx_country is not null))
      )::text
      from public.profiles p
      where p.account_status = 'active' and p.onboarding_completed_at is not null and not p.is_load_test

  member_location_text as (
    select p.id as profile_id,
           btrim(regexp_replace(translate(lower(p.location), 'áàâäãåāçćčéèêëēěíìîïīñńňóòôöõōřśšşúùûüūůýÿžźż', 'aaaaaaaccceeeeeeiiiiinnnoooooorsssuuuuuuyyzzz'), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g')) as whole_key,
           case when strpos(p.location, ',') > 0 then btrim(regexp_replace(translate(lower(split_part(p.location, ',', -1)), 'áàâäãåāçćčéèêëēěíìîïīñńňóòôöõōřśšşúùûüūůýÿžźż', 'aaaaaaaccceeeeeeiiiiinnnoooooorsssuuuuuuyyzzz'), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g')) end as last_key
    from public.profiles p
    where p.country_of_residence is null and p.location is not null
  ),
  member_location_country as (
    select t.profile_id, coalesce(w.code, l.code) as code
    from member_location_text t
    left join country_names w on w.alias = t.whole_key
    left join country_names l on l.alias = t.last_key
    where coalesce(w.code, l.code) is not null
  ),
  member_phone_country as (
    select distinct on (ia.profile_id) ia.profile_id, d.code
    from public.identity_accounts ia
    cross join generate_series(1, 6) as prefix_length(n)
    join country_dials d on d.prefix = substr(ia.phone_number, 2, prefix_length.n)
    where ia.phone_number like '+%'
    order by ia.profile_id, ia.phone_number_verified desc, ia.id, prefix_length.n desc
  ),
  member_first_session_country as (

    left join member_phone_country pc on pc.profile_id = p.id
    left join public.member_signup_countries sc on sc.profile_id = p.id
    left join member_first_session_country fs on fs.profile_id = p.id
    where true

        select dc.prefix, dc.code
        from public.profiles p
        join lateral (
          select d.prefix, d.code
          from public.identity_accounts ia
          cross join generate_series(1, 6) as l(n)
          join country_dials d on d.prefix = substr(ia.phone_number, 2, l.n)
          where ia.profile_id = p.id and ia.phone_number like '+%'
          order by ia.phone_number_verified desc, ia.id, l.n desc

        'live_personal', count(*) filter (where j.company_id is null)
      )::text
      from public.jobs j
      where j.status = 'published'
         and j.deleted_at is null
         and (
    case
      when j.company_id is not null then (
        exists (
        select 1 from public.account_subscriptions plan_current_j_c
        where plan_current_j_c.company_id = j.company_id
          and plan_current_j_c.status in ('trialing', 'active', 'past_due')
          and (plan_current_j_c.current_period_ends_at is null or plan_current_j_c.current_period_ends_at > now())
      )
        or exists (
        select 1 from public.entitlement_grants plan_grant_j_c
        where plan_grant_j_c.company_id = j.company_id
          and plan_grant_j_c.capability = 'job.publish'
          and plan_grant_j_c.revoked_at is null
          and (plan_grant_j_c.expires_at is null or plan_grant_j_c.expires_at > now())
      )
        or (j.hidden_for_plan_at is null and not exists (
        select 1 from public.account_subscriptions plan_past_j_c
        where plan_past_j_c.company_id = j.company_id
          and plan_past_j_c.status <> 'pending'
      ))
      )
      when j.created_by_user_id is null then j.hidden_for_plan_at is null
      else (
        exists (
        select 1 from public.account_subscriptions plan_current_j_p
        where plan_current_j_p.profile_id = j.created_by_user_id
          and plan_current_j_p.status in ('trialing', 'active', 'past_due')
          and (plan_current_j_p.current_period_ends_at is null or plan_current_j_p.current_period_ends_at > now())
      )
        or exists (
        select 1 from public.entitlement_grants plan_grant_j_p
        where plan_grant_j_p.profile_id = j.created_by_user_id
          and plan_grant_j_p.capability = 'job.publish'
          and plan_grant_j_p.revoked_at is null
          and (plan_grant_j_p.expires_at is null or plan_grant_j_p.expires_at > now())
      )
        or (j.hidden_for_plan_at is null and not exists (
        select 1 from public.account_subscriptions plan_past_j_p
        where plan_past_j_p.profile_id = j.created_by_user_id
          and plan_past_j_p.status <> 'pending'
      ))
      )
    end
  )
         and (j.apply_until is null or j.apply_until >= current_date)
         and (coalesce(j.joining_until, j.joining_from) is null or coalesce(j.joining_until, j.joining_from) >= current_date)

  member_location_text as (
    select p.id as profile_id,
           btrim(regexp_replace(translate(lower(p.location), 'áàâäãåāçćčéèêëēěíìîïīñńňóòôöõōřśšşúùûüūůýÿžźż', 'aaaaaaaccceeeeeeiiiiinnnoooooorsssuuuuuuyyzzz'), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g')) as whole_key,
           case when strpos(p.location, ',') > 0 then btrim(regexp_replace(translate(lower(split_part(p.location, ',', -1)), 'áàâäãåāçćčéèêëēěíìîïīñńňóòôöõōřśšşúùûüūůýÿžźż', 'aaaaaaaccceeeeeeiiiiinnnoooooorsssuuuuuuyyzzz'), '[^a-z0-9]+', ' ', 'g')) end as last_key
    from public.profiles p
    where p.country_of_residence is null and p.location is not null
  ),
  member_location_country as (
    select t.profile_id, coalesce(w.code, l.code) as code
    from member_location_text t
    left join country_names w on w.alias = t.whole_key
    left join country_names l on l.alias = t.last_key
    where coalesce(w.code, l.code) is not null
  ),
  member_phone_country as (
    select distinct on (ia.profile_id) ia.profile_id, d.code
    from public.identity_accounts ia
    cross join generate_series(1, 6) as prefix_length(n)
    join country_dials d on d.prefix = substr(ia.phone_number, 2, prefix_length.n)
    where ia.phone_number like '+%'
    order by ia.profile_id, ia.phone_number_verified desc, ia.id, prefix_length.n desc
  ),
  member_first_session_country as (
    select distinct on (s.profile_id) s.profile_id, s.approx_country as code
    from public.auth_sessions s
    where s.approx_country is not null
    order by s.profile_id, s.created_at asc, s.id asc
  ),
  member_country as (
    select p.id as profile_id,
           coalesce(p.country_of_residence, lc.code, pc.code, sc.country_code, fs.code) as code,
           case
             when p.country_of_residence is not null then 'profile'
             when lc.code is not null then 'location'
             when pc.code is not null then 'phone'
             when sc.country_code is not null or fs.code is not null then 'signup'
           end as source
    from public.profiles p
    left join member_location_country lc on lc.profile_id = p.id
    left join member_phone_country pc on pc.profile_id = p.id
    left join public.member_signup_countries sc on sc.profile_id = p.id
    left join member_first_session_country fs on fs.profile_id = p.id
    where true

      members as (
        select coalesce(mc.code, '') as code, mc.source, p.created_at, exists (select 1 from public.feature_verifications fv where fv.profile_id = p.id and fv.status = 'approved') as verified
        from public.profiles p
        join member_country mc on mc.profile_id = p.id
        where p.account_status = 'active' and p.onboarding_completed_at is not null and not p.is_load_test
      ),
      member_counts as (
        select code,
               count(*) as registered,
               count(*) filter (where verified) as verified,
               count(*) filter (where created_at >= now() - interval '7 days') as new_week,
               count(*) filter (where created_at >= now() - interval '30 days') as new_month,
               count(*) filter (where source in ('location', 'phone', 'signup')) as estimated
        from members
        group by code
      ),
      organization_counts as (
        select coalesce(c.country, '') as code, count(*) as organizations
        from public.companies c
        group by 1
      ),
      job_counts as (
        select coalesce(case when j.company_id is not null then jc.country else poster.code end, '') as code, count(*) as active_jobs
        from public.jobs j
        left join public.companies jc on jc.id = j.company_id
        left join member_country poster on poster.profile_id = j.created_by_user_id
        where j.status = 'published'
         and j.deleted_at is null
         and (
    case
      when j.company_id is not null then (
        exists (
        select 1 from public.account_subscriptions plan_current_j_c
        where plan_current_j_c.company_id = j.company_id
          and plan_current_j_c.status in ('trialing', 'active', 'past_due')
          and (plan_current_j_c.current_period_ends_at is null or plan_current_j_c.current_period_ends_at > now())
      )
        or exists (
        select 1 from public.entitlement_grants plan_grant_j_c
        where plan_grant_j_c.company_id = j.company_id
          and plan_grant_j_c.capability = 'job.publish'
          and plan_grant_j_c.revoked_at is null
          and (plan_grant_j_c.expires_at is null or plan_grant_j_c.expires_at > now())
      )
        or (j.hidden_for_plan_at is null and not exists (
        select 1 from public.account_subscriptions plan_past_j_c
        where plan_past_j_c.company_id = j.company_id
          and plan_past_j_c.status <> 'pending'
      ))
      )
      when j.created_by_user_id is null then j.hidden_for_plan_at is null
      else (
        exists (
        select 1 from public.account_subscriptions plan_current_j_p
        where plan_current_j_p.profile_id = j.created_by_user_id
          and plan_current_j_p.status in ('trialing', 'active', 'past_due')
          and (plan_current_j_p.current_period_ends_at is null or plan_current_j_p.current_period_ends_at > now())
      )
        or exists (
        select 1 from public.entitlement_grants plan_grant_j_p
        where plan_grant_j_p.profile_id = j.created_by_user_id
          and plan_grant_j_p.capability = 'job.publish'
          and plan_grant_j_p.revoked_at is null
          and (plan_grant_j_p.expires_at is null or plan_grant_j_p.expires_at > now())
      )
        or (j.hidden_for_plan_at is null and not exists (
        select 1 from public.account_subscriptions plan_past_j_p
        where plan_past_j_p.profile_id = j.created_by_user_id
          and plan_past_j_p.status <> 'pending'
      ))
      )
    end
  )
         and (j.apply_until is null or j.apply_until >= current_date)
         and (coalesce(j.joining_until, j.joining_from) is null or coalesce(j.joining_until, j.joining_from) >= current_date)
        group by 1
      ),
      codes as (
        select code from member_counts union select code from organization_counts union select code from job_counts
      )
      select codes.code, m.registered, m.verified, m.new_week, m.new_month, m.estimated, o.organizations, jc.active_jobs
      from codes
      left join member_counts m on m.code = codes.code
      left join organization_counts o on o.code = codes.code
      left join job_counts jc on jc.code = codes.code
      ) s
